coverage.method: Pinned public release metadata, selected repository source and documentation; no population-wide market or forum sample.

products.name: Cockpit Tools
products.sourceClaims: Broad provider coverage, model quota, profile instances; release addresses Windows secure-auth switching, bulk import stalls and stale profile refresh.
products.identityProofLimit: Release notes and selected source were reviewed; no Windows runtime account confirmation was independently exercised.

products.name: Antigravity Tools / Antigravity Manager
products.sourceClaims: Account/model quotas and extensive OpenAI/Gemini/Anthropic proxy routing; proxy features exceed Egoist's current local profile scope.
products.identityProofLimit: A selected account label is not runtime identity proof. Issue 3598 was closed on October 5 and remains a regression scenario, not evidence of a present release defect.

products.name: Codex Account Switcher — liuzhao1225
products.sourceClaims: Outgoing credential preservation, quota handling, target credential verification before reopening.
products.identityProofLimit: Pre-launch credential verification cannot itself establish the account of a reopened Desktop process; Store end-to-end support was not independently tested.

products.name: Codex Account Switcher — korsun009
products.sourceClaims: DPAPI profiles, shared Codex home, quota and optional Telegram control; README explicitly describes an unsigned 2.0.0 release despite its signing build gate.
products.identityProofLimit: Signing gate documentation and DPAPI claims are not independent binary or runtime identity verification.
products.comparisonRole: Windows architecture and shared-home design reference

products.name: Codex Switcher — unkdevv
products.sourceClaims: DPAPI vault, outgoing credential backfill, OAuth and atomic encrypted profile handling.
products.identityProofLimit: No reopened runtime identity or native resource measurement was performed.
products.comparisonRole: Native Windows vault and repair design reference

products.name: Codex Switcher — Lampese
products.licenseDeclared: No license identified in reviewed repository
products.sourceClaims: OAuth, quotas, tray and serialized operations; selected source includes a LAN web surface.
products.identityProofLimit: No runtime/native benchmark. License issue was opened August 3 and triaged September 30; code is independently implemented in Egoist.

products.name: Codex AccountSwitch — isxlan0
products.sourceClaims: OAuth, five-hour/seven-day display, proxy mode and batch transfer.
products.identityProofLimit: A no-restart proxy claim is not Desktop session identity proof; external WebView2 runtime changes installer-size comparability.
products.comparisonRole: Small native shell and transfer reference

products.name: CC Switch
products.sourceClaims: Provider/configuration switching, MCP, prompts, proxy failover and usage.
products.identityProofLimit: Configuration switching and API routing differ from switching an authenticated Codex Desktop session.

products.name: CodexBar
products.sourceClaims: Broad provider usage monitoring. Selected docs also describe explicit System Account promotion; the app is not accurately described as monitoring-only.
products.identityProofLimit: Account view selection, explicit system-account promotion and runtime identity are distinct. No upstream Windows GUI release exists in the reviewed release assets.
products.comparisonRole: Quota/source-freshness reference; Windows native comparison N/A

products.name: Win-CodexBar
products.sourceClaims: Windows provider quota monitoring, tray, privacy, CLI and multiple credential acquisition methods.
products.identityProofLimit: Monitoring multiple credentials is not a verified Desktop-switch contract; no resource or signature exercise was performed.

products.name: Quotio
products.stackDeclared: Native macOS / Rust helper and CLI
products.sourceClaims: Usage cache, last-good-data handling and read-only loopback helper. Beta CLI assets explicitly exclude Windows.
products.identityProofLimit: No reviewed Windows package; source/cache behavior is a design reference, not a measured Windows competitor.
products.comparisonRole: Snapshot/transport contract reference; Windows native comparison N/A

products.name: 1DevTool
products.stackDeclared: Electron desktop workspace; not an independently reviewed source distribution
products.sourceClaims: Multi-CLI workspace and account controls; vendor advertises permanent free tier and Pro at $29/$59/$89 for one/three/five devices with twelve months of updates.
products.identityProofLimit: Vendor claims and downloadable release metadata were reviewed; paid access, provider-specific account flows and resource use were not tested.

globalLimits: No same-hardware competitor CPU/RAM/startup measurement is available in this record.
Release metadata SHA-256 is an advertised digest, not a locally verified downloaded binary hash.
Installer bytes cannot rank runtime memory or include every external WebView2/shared runtime dependency.
Repository declarations and selected source findings do not establish current signed binary behavior.
Public reports are selected failure cases, not prevalence estimates or proof of malicious behavior.
No competitor code was copied into this implementation.
